A. CONNECTED PROSE -- complete sentences that follow from one another, where the
   relationships between the points are spelled out in words.

   relates them to each other, whether or not the items are full sentences.

PASSAGE
-------
The submission deadline is 1 March 2026. All rules apply then. Manuscripts require at least 22 pages, though exactly that count satisfies the length rule. Format demands either the official template or three years documented revision history. Venue presentations at Tier-1 venues disqualify submissions unless occurring more than 18 months prior; exactly 18 months fails. Prior round acceptances disqualify work if fewer than five years elapsed, yet exactly five passes. Paired submissions allow two manuscripts only, both needing independent R1 and R2 compliance, with at least one satisfying the venue rule. Track D exempts format requirements but mandates exactly two endorsements instead. Retracted manuscripts are never handled, overriding all other rules regardless of figure counts or adjustments. Figure limits range from 8 to 45 inclusive, extending to 70 for paired submissions. Shortage triggers padding rather than return, assigning a PADDED verdict unless another rule failure occurs; exceeding maximums causes immediate return. Withdrawals reset venue clocks to the withdrawal date for calculation purposes but do not count as acceptances under prior round restrictions. Every submission resolves to one of three outcomes: HANDLED if fully compliant, RETURNED upon any rule failure, or PADDED specifically for minor figure deficits corrected automatically. Ensure precise adherence to these constraints before issuing final decisions affecting real submitters.
